candidate.tool_identifier_rule: complete ASCII tool name/key leaf match after conservative singularization only
candidate.specificity_rule: mean catalog discrimination log((N+1)/(df+1))/log(N+1), used only as equal-score tie-break

selection_rationale: The original minimal-intervention DEV selector chose STRUCT-1.5-1.5 and that variant passed the global per-catalog 0.97 gates.
Post-selection DEV subgroup diagnostics showed residual clear-single-tool and mixed-language weaknesses for STRUCT-1.5-1.5.
DEV is the tuning surface, so subgroup diagnostics may be used before confirmation is opened.

STRUCT-4.5-1.5 was the lowest operation-family bonus among variants achieving 100% Recall@10 and FullCoverage@10 across every catalog, supported stratum and language while losing zero previously covered required routes.
STRUCT-4.5-3.0 was equally perfect but uses a larger unnecessary operation-family bonus and is therefore not selected.
promotion_sequence: implement candidate as opt-in core behavior with default disabled
prove exact ranking parity between research evaluator and core implementation on the frozen DEV surface
only then generate/open the sealed confirmation surface
promote to product default only if confirmation gates pass
